author: Jacob Grimm, Wilhelm Grimm
video_title: The Story of Rapunzel | Disneyland Record 1969 | A Grimm Fairy Tale
description:
A Grimm fairy tale, first published in 1812.
This is a  Disneyland Records recording from 1969, read by Rica Moore.
Illustrations presented with the reading are from a  2010 Sterling publication of Rapunzel, illustrations by Fiona Sansom. Also a 2006 Ladybird Tales publication with an illustration by Ruth Palmer.
